name: io.github.yankiifr/base-facts-mcp
title: Base Token Facts
description: Base token checks for agents: simulated buy and sell, taxes, honeypots. Pay per call in USDC (x402).

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a small x402 payer wallet holding a little USDC on Base (pays $0.002-$0.01 per call). Alternative: X402_PAYER_FILE.

environmentVariables.name: SESSION_BUDGET_USD
environmentVariables.description: Stop paying once this much was spent in the session (default 1).
